cells.quote:
The case study reveals a productive tension between these students’ experiments with posthumanist literacy and their entrenched humanistic assumptions.

Zhimo’s literacy practices with AI technologies, along with his guided reflection on these practices, can be characterized as the quintessential embodiment of a humanistic approach with a critical-pragmatic orientation.
